explication: This repository is the G.A.M.M.A. modpack for STALKER Anomaly; the supplied tree and source excerpts cover shader add-ons and graphics patches, not the modpack’s broader gameplay systems. The visible workflow is the game’s renderer using shader code for lighting, screen-space effects, color transforms, and HDR output. Major shader variants are kept separate by add-on and renderer generation. Edges are limited to include relationships named in the SOURCE INDEX; renderer integration and unsampled effects are not inferred as verified calls.
